column5: Close-up studio portrait of an elderly fisherman with a weathered face, salt-and-pepper beard and a knitted wool cap, soft window light, shallow depth of field, 85mm photograph.
Portrait of a young woman with freckles and curly red hair laughing in golden-hour light in a wheat field, candid film photograph.
A chef in a white uniform plating a dessert in a busy restaurant kitchen, steam and warm tungsten lights, documentary photo.
A vintage neon sign that reads "OPEN ALL NIGHT" glowing above a rainy diner window at midnight, reflections on the wet street.
A storefront with 'Google Brain Toronto' written on it.
A hand-lettered chalkboard menu outside a cafe reading "Fresh Coffee 3 dollars", with a potted plant and morning sun.
Geology cross-section poster of Earth layers, including crust, mantle, outer and inner core, with detailed depths, temperatures and labels.
A movie poster titled "THE LAST LIGHTHOUSE" showing a lone lighthouse on a cliff during a storm, dramatic lightning, bold serif title text.
Liquid-mercury 3D letters of MEND, placed on a dark reflective stage with volumetric spotlights and crisp product-render detail.
A bustling night market in Taipei with lanterns, food stalls, steam rising from dumplings and crowds of people, cinematic wide shot.
Floodlit stadium football moment: striker mid bicycle-kick, roaring crowd, flags, turf spray, sweat droplets in the background, and motion blur effect.
A misty alpine lake at sunrise surrounded by pine forest and snow-capped peaks, perfectly still water reflecting the mountains.
A cozy reading nook by a rain-streaked window with a knitted blanket, a steaming mug of tea and a stack of old books, warm lamp light.
A futuristic city skyline at dusk with flying cars and holographic billboards, highly detailed digital art.
A narrow cobblestone alley in an Italian village with laundry lines, flower boxes and a cat sitting on a doorstep, afternoon light.
A red fox curled up asleep in fresh snow, frost on its fur, soft blue morning light, wildlife photography.
A golden retriever puppy wearing a tiny yellow raincoat, splashing in a puddle, photo.
A snowy owl in flight with wings fully spread against a dark forest background, every feather sharply detailed.
A panda making latte art.
A herd of elephants crossing a dusty savanna river at sunset, backlit dust, telephoto shot.
A luxury mechanical wristwatch with a skeleton dial showing gears and jewels, macro product photograph on black slate.
High-speed macro of a water-droplet crown frozen mid-splash on a colorful surface, elegant and detailed.
A glass teapot with blooming jasmine tea on a wooden table, soft backlight, steam, and refracted light.
Stacked wooden animal totem with bear at the bottom, eagle in the middle and fish on top, with weathered paint, forest bokeh and warm light.
A laptop on top of a teddy bear.
A photo of a vase right of a horse.
A red colored car next to a blue colored bicycle.
A photo of four apples on a white plate.
A blue coloured pizza.
An astronaut riding a horse on the surface of the moon, Earth rising in the background.
A watercolor painting of a lighthouse on a rocky coast with crashing waves and seagulls, loose brush strokes.
A Studio Ghibli style illustration of a small girl and a giant forest spirit waiting at a rural bus stop in the rain.
A Van Gogh style oil painting of a cat sitting on a windowsill at night with swirling stars outside.
An isometric 3D render of a tiny cozy bakery with warm lights, pastel colors, clay material, soft shadows.
A detailed ink and pencil fantasy map of an island kingdom with mountains, forests, rivers and hand-written place names.
A stained glass window depicting a hummingbird drinking from a flower, vivid colors, sunlight shining through.
A hair drier underneath a sheep.
Five cars on the street.
A person's hands playing a piano, close-up, all ten fingers clearly visible on the keys.
A 1940s train-station farewell: a couple embraces through steam and sepia backlight, with vintage clothing, cinematic nostalgia, and a station sign reading MEND.
